verdicts.reason: A: the NEW VIDEO badge is shrunk to an unreadable pink chip that sits on top of the VOLTSTRIDE logo, an unwanted collision. The lime circle is pulled away from the shoe and left as a meaningless disc clipped at the far right edge, which breaks the key image. B: the shoe and circle stay together, but the circle is small, offset and clipped at the edge. The logo is jammed into the top-right corner against the shoe, there is dead space at the far left, and the subcopy and NEW VIDEO badge are tiny. Both are flawed, but B keeps the original's shoe-and-circle image more intact and has no direct collision.
